about: Decision 0012 §2, as an allowlist (planner ruling, game-7, 2026-10-30): the quests that may run after a new game and after 1, 10 and 50 in-game days. Every other self-starting quest of the load order (start-game-enabled or started by the story manager, listed by ArgoniaGen quests), whether base game, Creation Club or a mod's, is generated as an inert shell override. A dependency mod's controller quest stays, with its reason per row; a story mod's quests do not (King of the Murkmire: we borrow its cells, never its quests). The journey (0.4 §b) compares the bridge's running quests with 'running'.
